about: Pipeline legs, declared once (milestone 0014 plan SC1; ADR 0005 'Matrix / legs'). stage.py validates --leg/CI_LEG against this file and reads every per-leg value from it (preset, build configuration, runner key into pins.json, sudo for live-table runs). The workflow matrix carries only the leg name. 'tiers' is the Q1 ruling (status.md 2026-11-12): a push to a branch other than master runs the 'push_branch' legs; every other event (pull request, push to master, v* tag, schedule, manual) runs 'full'. Packaging legs (<os>-<arch>, ADR 0005 D1) are declared but 'pending' until milestone 0012 names the shipped configuration (Story 03.0) and adds the libsmbios install rules (Story 01.0); stage.py refuses a pending leg with exit 2. 'unit_tests'/'live_table_tests' select the test-stage sets of test_sets.json run through ctest_report.py (Story 03.0 Task 02): C06/C10 on Windows; Q4 live-table under sudo on the plain Linux leg; C13 (unit) and C14 (live-table, macOS only - Q4 skips it under sanitizers on Linux) on the sanitizer legs. 'job' names the workflow job that runs the leg ('build' when absent, or 'sanitizers': configured into build/<preset>-asan with the C12 flags, asan vcpkg cache flavor; stage-sanitizers.yml). 'tiers' list legs of every job; each job's workflow matrix equals its own legs of the tier. GUI legs (Story 03.0 Task 03, inventory C15-C20) have 'job': 'gui' (stage-gui.yml): build/<os>-gui via the <os>-gui preset, gui vcpkg cache flavor, 'apt_packages' runs apt_install.py (C15, Linux only), and the test stage runs the gui steps (C17-C20); 'config' Debug is the old gui-build job's ctest -C Debug on every OS. Q1: the push_branch tier is the three Linux legs (linux, linux-asan, linux-gui).
